answers.question: What drove Microsoft's revenue growth in fiscal year 2026?
answers.text: Microsoft’s revenue increased $50.1 billion, or 18%, in fiscal year 2026, driven by growth in Microsoft Cloud [C1]. Specifically, Intelligent Cloud revenue increased driven by Azure, and Productivity and Business Processes revenue increased driven by Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud [C1]. More Personal Computing revenue decreased, but this was offset by growth in Search advertising [C1]. Total revenue for fiscal year 2026 was $331,839 million, an increase from the $281,724 million in fiscal year 2025 [F2].
